hypotheses.construct: cube_close_long daily returns over the 12-1 formation window: ID = sign(cum_ret) * (%neg_days - %pos_days); path-smoothness overlay ON residual momentum (H003) -- boost momentum names with continuous (low-ID, many small same-sign days) paths, fade discrete (jumpy) ones. hypotheses.rationale: Durable: gradual/continuous information diffuses under limited attention and momentum CONTINUES; jumpy discrete moves reverse. A momentum-QUALITY refinement orthogonal to momentum magnitude; behavioral rationale not a curve-fit.

hypotheses.construct: panel_long (21yr): for each name, mean historical own-return in the SAME upcoming calendar month across all prior years (expanding, PIT -- only years < t); cross-sectional z per date. e.g. rank names by their historical-January return going into January.

hypotheses.name: Greenblatt Magic Formula (EY + return-on-capital)
hypotheses.construct: rank-average of (a) earnings yield EY (stock_valuation_pit) and (b) return-on-capital proxy = operating_profit/total_assets (MASTER PIT). hypotheses.construct: rank-average of: op_profitability (op_profit/total_assets), -beta_252 (safe/BAB), -(borrowings/op_profit) (low leverage), earnings-stability (inverse std of trailing 5y annual net_profit growth, panel_long+MASTER PIT). hypotheses.construct: MASTER_fundamentals_pit: inverse coefficient-of-variation of trailing 5y annual net_profit (or annual EPS) growth, PIT available_date; cross-sectional z. High stability = high score.
hypotheses.kill: default; expected to be a REGIME leg (stronger in bears) -- judge on 21yr panel_long across bear windows, not bull-only IC; park if no positive IC in any regime split
hypotheses.rationale: Durable: predictable-earnings firms command a premium and defend in drawdowns (matches our regime-map: quality wins in bears). Orthogonal to momentum; a quality dimension distinct from profitability LEVEL (this is profitability STABILITY).

Judge on Sharpe/DD of the momentum sleeve, NOT raw CAGR (lesson #11 / K-015: overlays are risk tools).
